infoLinks.urlText: West Ryde Station Lift 3 between the concourse and Platform 3 is not available
infoLinks.content:
At West Ryde Station Lift 3 between the concourse and Platform 3 is temporarily out of service.
From Wednesday 28 October until Friday 18 December, the lift between the concourse and Platform 3 will be closed for lift replacement works.

If you need lift access from the concourse to Platform 3, catch a train from Platform 1 or 2 and change at Rhodes Station to return via Platform 3.

If you arrive on Platform 3 and need lift access to the concourse, catch a train to Eastwood Station and return via Platform 1 or 2.

Alternatively, lift access to the station will be available on the opposite side of the station on Ryedale Road. Baggage handlers will be available to assist during busy times.

If you need further assistance, ask station staff or call 02 9752 8465.
If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9752 8465.
